The symptoms of diabetes include a range of signs that can affect different parts of the body, including:

* Increased thirst and frequent urination
* Unexplained weight loss
* Fatigue
* Blurred vision
* Slow-healing sores
* Frequent infections

Type 1 diabetes symptoms may appear suddenly, while Type 2 diabetes symptoms develop gradually over time.

If you are experiencing any of these symptoms, it is essential to consult a healthcare professional for proper diagnosis and treatment. They can help determine the underlying cause of your symptoms and provide guidance on managing your condition.
